description: Combine the accepted L2-prefetched n=512 plus cached direct-FP32 n=2048 stack with the tile-major FP16 n=512 factor-sidecar winner. Import only sidecar allocation, solved-factor conversion, contiguous asynchronous triple staging, and its shape-local launch state; preserve direct n=2048, specialized n=1024, deterministic n=256, every other dispatch, caller-stream rebinding, cache resets, repeated outputs, fresh inputs, and the full validation grid.

Combined the accepted n512 L2-prefetched async pair path and stream-bound cached launcher with a full tile-major FP16 solved-factor sidecar, contiguous async triple staging, and cached per-input sidecar launch state; full validation and fresh-input guard passed, with all 15 ranked shapes at 914.651 us.

Added L2::128B residency hints to each contiguous 16-byte load in the tile-major FP16 factor-sidecar triple prefetch while retaining the parent hint on FP32 pair staging and cached stream launcher; validation and fresh-input guard passed, target measured 1606.331 us versus 1605.183, and the full-grid metric measured 912.313 us versus 914.651.

Fused cp.async wait-group completion and the required CTA barrier inside the linked helper, removing three separate Numba synchronization sites from sidecar triple staging; validation and fresh-input guard passed, target improved from 1606.331 to 1604.376 us while full-grid metric measured 914.113 us versus 912.313.

Padded each full tile-major FP16 sidecar row from 16 to 17 tiles, shifting consecutive sample strides away from the 512 KiB power-of-two mapping while retaining L2 hints, triple staging, and fused wait/barrier; validation passed, target measured 1608.175 us versus 1604.376, and full-grid metric measured 912.446 us versus 914.113.

Replaced per-row sidecar padding with one 2 KiB tile between consecutive samples, retaining contiguous 16x16 tile rows while shifting each sample's cache mapping; validation passed, target measured 1607.095 us versus 1608.175 with row padding, and full-grid metric measured 914.093 us versus 912.446.

Restored the unpadded 16x16 tile-major sidecar and separate wait/barrier sites, then widened only the three contiguous FP16 async sidecar prefetch hints from L2::128B to L2::256B; validation passed, target measured 1650.380 us versus 1606.331 for 128B, and full-grid metric measured 919.268 us versus 912.313.

Measured six validated combine variants. The direct L2-pair plus full tile-major FP16 sidecar import reached 914.651 us aggregate / 1605.183 us target at 0422315. Adding L2::128B to all three contiguous half-sidecar streams produced the best aggregate, 912.313 us at ba6af9a, with target 1606.331 us. Fused wait/barrier reached 914.113 / 1604.376; 17-tile row padding reached 912.446 / 1608.175; one-tile sample padding reached 914.093 / 1607.095; L2::256B half hints reached 919.268 / 1650.380. Every variant passed build, policy gates, 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and all 15 cells; caller-stream launcher caching and every non-n512 path stayed intact. Local profiling was waived and hosted Brev was unavailable. Keep this objective moving from ba6af9a with repeated-noise confirmation, a precomputed compact-sidecar offset table that avoids packed-index arithmetic, cp.async.bulk/TMA plus mbarrier staging, or direct MathDx solved-factor emission that removes duplicate FP32+FP16 writeback.
